title: Checkout deployment enters CrashLoopBackOff
keywords: checkout crashloopbackoff crashloop restarting restarts reiniciando oomkilled memory memoria
body: Fictional incident. Check the failing revision, pod events, previous container logs and the last termination reason. If the reason is OOMKilled, compare peak memory with the container limit and compare the new revision against the last stable one. Confirm readiness and error-rate recovery after any human-approved rollback.

title: Ingress returns HTTP 502 after a rollout
keywords: ingress gateway edge 502 bad upstream readiness rollout endpoint endpointslices
body: Fictional incident. Compare ingress errors against ready replicas. Check whether Service selectors match pod labels, EndpointSlices contain ready addresses, and the Service targetPort matches the application listener. If the new revision correlates with the errors, escalate to the service owner with the evidence.

title: PostgreSQL connection pool saturation
keywords: postgres postgresql database banco pool connections conexoes rds saturation exhausted
body: Fictional incident. Compare pool wait time, open connections and application replica count against the configured database connection limit. Inspect active queries and lock waits. Escalate with the combined connection budget before requesting larger pools or more replicas.

title: Order queue backlog keeps growing
keywords: queue fila backlog sqs consumer consumers oldest atraso messages mensagens drain
body: Fictional incident. Compare enqueue and processing rates and the age of the oldest message. Check consumer error rates, recent deployments and dead-letter queue volume. Check the downstream capacity before proposing additional workers.

title: GitHub Actions is blocked by a Terraform state lock
keywords: terraform state lock locked pipeline github actions ci bloqueado trava
body: Fictional incident. Identify the state backend and correlate the lock owner with running workflows. Wait for the owning workflow to finish or ask the platform team to verify that the lock is stale. Serialize workflows targeting the same state and verify a subsequent plan after remediation.

title: Intermittent DNS failures inside the cluster
keywords: dns coredns nxdomain servfail resolution resolving resolucao lookup
body: Fictional incident. Compare queries from affected and healthy pods. Inspect DNS latency, SERVFAIL rates and CoreDNS health. Verify the requested name and namespace, then compare resolver configuration and upstream errors.
